courses.title: Kotlin Foundations
courses.description: Learn the language behind modern Android apps, one clear concept at a time.

lessons.title: Your first Kotlin program
lessons.content: Kotlin is concise, expressive, and designed to work well on the JVM. Start with fun main() and print().

lessons.title: Values and variables
lessons.content: Use val for values that do not change and var for values that can be reassigned.

lessons.title: Functions and parameters
lessons.content: Functions group reusable steps and can return a value.

quiz.title: Kotlin Foundations Checkpoint
quiz.description: A short check on the first Kotlin lessons.

questions.questionText: Which keyword declares a read-only value?
Which keyword starts a function declaration?

courses.title: Python for Curious Minds
courses.description: Practice useful Python basics through friendly examples and small programs.

lessons.title: Meet Python
lessons.content: Python is a readable general-purpose language used for scripting, data, and web development.

lessons.title: Collections and loops
lessons.content: Lists hold ordered values. A for loop visits each item in a collection.

lessons.title: Write a small function
lessons.content: Use def to define a function, then call it with the values it needs.

questions.questionText: Which keyword defines a function in Python?
Which collection keeps items in order and can be changed?

courses.title: Web Pages with JavaScript
courses.description: Add behavior to web pages with events, values, and simple functions.

lessons.title: Values in JavaScript
lessons.content: JavaScript supports strings, numbers, booleans, arrays, and objects.

lessons.title: Respond to a click
lessons.content: An event listener lets a page respond when a learner interacts with it.

lessons.title: Small reusable functions
lessons.content: Functions let you name and reuse steps in a program.

quiz.title: JavaScript Web Checkpoint
quiz.description: Check the essentials of browser-side JavaScript.

questions.questionText: Which method listens for a browser event?
Which value represents true or false?
